name: Question 19
problem:
The volumes of some chocolate muffins before cooking are normally distributed with a mean of $57\,\text{ml}$ and a standard deviation of $2\,\text{ml}.$ The volumes of some pumpkin muffins before cooking are normally distributed with a mean of $42\,\text{ml}$ and a standard deviation of $1\,\text{ml}.$  During cooking, it is known that chocolate muffins double in volume, while pumpkin muffins triple in volume.

If a chocolate muffin and a  pumpkin muffin are randomly selected after cooking, what is the probability that the sum of their volumes is more than $240\,\text{ml}$ but less than $250\,\text{ml}?$ You may assume that the volumes of the muffins are independent. 

*Hint: A table of values of $Φ(z)$ for different values of $z$ is given below, where $Φ(z)$ is the cumulative distribution function for the standard normal distribution. *

| $z$ | $\,0.00\,$ | $\,0.01\,$ | $\,0.02\,$ | $\,0.03\,$ | $\,0.04\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\,2.0\,$ | $\,0.9772\,$ | $\,0.9778\,$ | $\,0.9783\,$ | $\,0.9788\,$ | $\,0.9793\,$ |
| $\,2.1\,$ | $\,0.9821\,$ | $\,0.9826\,$ | $\,0.9830\,$ | $\,0.9834\,$ | $\,0.9838\,$ |
| $\,2.2\,$ | $\,0.9861\,$ | $\,0.9864\,$ | $\,0.9868\,$ | $\,0.9871\,$ | $\,0.9875\,$ |
worked_solution:
Let $X$ denote the volume of a chocolate muffin before cooking, and let $Y$ denote the volume of a pumpkin muffin before cooking. We want to find 

$$
P(240<2X+3Y<250).
$$

Since $X$ and $Y$ are  independent random variables such that $X∼N(57,{2}^{2})$ and $Y∼N(42,{1}^{2})$, then 

$$
\begin{aligned}2X+3Y & ∼N(2\cdot 57+3\cdot 42,{2}^{2}\cdot {2}^{2}+{3}^{2}\cdot 1) \\  & ∼N(240,25).\end{aligned}
$$

So, the variable $2X+3Y$ is normally distributed with mean $\mu =240$ and standard deviation $\sigma =\sqrt{25}=5.$

In order to find $P(100<2X+3Y<120),$ we convert $2X+3Y$ to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(240<2X+3Y<250) & =P(\frac{240-240}{5}<Z<\frac{250-240}{5}) \\  & =P(0<Z<2) \\  & =P(Z<2)-P(Z\le 0) \\  & =P(Z\le 2)-P(Z\le 0) \\  & =Φ(2)-Φ(0)\end{aligned}
$$

Using the $z$-table, we see that

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(2) & ≈0.9772,\end{aligned}
$$

and we know that

$$
\begin{aligned}Φ(0) & =0.5.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(240<2X+3Y<250) & =Φ(2)-Φ(0) \\  & ≈0.9772-0.5 \\  & =0.4772.\end{aligned}
$$
